notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; neither a hardware device nor a CARLA server was attached or run. The fake backend (fake.py) is this package's pure-Python kinematic stand-in for src.env.environment:CarlaEnv, not the upstream environment: it returns a 4 x 4 x 3 RGB image and a 3 x 4 LiDAR array instead of the upstream 360 x 640 x 3 and 3 x 500 arrays (the real sizes are named in the fidelity gaps), and it was never compared with CARLA. The sim backend (gymnasium.make of carla-rl-gym-v0, which needs the clone on sys.path, the carla package and a CARLA server at localhost:2000) was not run. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the pending seed of the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for bridge-derived inputs (reset.seed, seed.seed, step.ticks and step.action.values); there is no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
